title: Design and Construction of a Modernized Facility (Building 129 Lunch and Locker Room Facility) at McAlester Army Ammunition Plant (MCAAP)
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > AMC > ACC > ACC-CTRS > ACC RI > W6QK ACC-RI
description:
DESCRIPTION:  
The Army Contracting Command-Rock Island (ACC-RI), on behalf of the McAlester Army Ammunition Plant (MCAAP) Directorate of Public Works (DPW), is seeking capable sources for the design and construction of a modernized facility (Renovation and Modernization of Building 129, Lunch and Locker Room Facility) capable of supporting consolidated personnel operations at MCAAP while complying with strict Department of Defense physical security, environmental, and facility modernization standards.  
 
The United States Government (Government) intends to utilize the information submitted in response to this Sources Sought Notice (SSN) to issue a follow-on Request for Solutions (RFS) that will encompass the full requirement for the modernized Building 129 facility. The Government is contemplating using a Stand-Alone Other Transaction Agreement (OTA) under 10 U.S.C. § 2808a (Facility construction or repair: transactions other than contracts and grants) to satisfy this requirement. 
 
This authority allows the Department of Defense to carry out repair and construction projects for facilities outside the traditional Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) framework. However, if the acquisition approach changes, the information obtained from this SSN will be utilized in the planning and award of the project. 
 
The United States Governement's (Government) intends to award the proposed transaction(s) based on the capabilities demonstrated in response to the RFS; therefore, all interested sources shall ensure that they have fully identified, in writing, their capabilities to perform the requirements included in this SSN and subsequent updates. 
 
The Government encourages responses from traditional defense contractors, non­traditional defense contractors, construction technology companies, commercial innovators, and consortia, even if they have not previously performed work for the Department of Defense.
